meaning: The draft 2 normative text, schemas and conformance suite are fixed at this pin for open review and for white paper revision 3. A change to any normative file or expected result creates a new candidate; results stay attached to the pin that produced them.

verification.procedure: one pass: corpus check, both reference consumers over every case with every actual result compared, the shared specimen verifier, npm run gates

unreviewed_changes.summary: Text-decided fixes from the review round in the affected consumers, a revert of an observed-request name check, five clarifying sentences, eight cases and specimen documentation corrections.

The specification owner's decisions on the round's open questions: deployment binding conditions before availability conditions, admission of a fresh REJECTED attempt on a consumed permit, removal of the failed_checks cap, and the statement that the reservation transition does not compare the observed request with actual fields; five cases.

known_limitations: No independent review has accepted the access-card correspondence subject (AC-REV-001); every specimen's review acts are labelled synthetic proxies.
Draft 2 has no mutation catalog, generated-property suite or closed requirement-coverage record.
The Python consumer's unit tests under python/tests are stale and outside the gates.
A disputed effect has no attributable human exit in draft 2.
later_candidate_items: CR-02a and CR-02b: disposition of a disputed reservation and lifecycle dispute clearance
